purpose: Exploratory matched fan-off/fan-on reference-microphone source characterization; no ANC playback.
device_name: Microphone Array (Intel® Smart Sound Technology for Digital Microphones)
analysis_units: Digital amplitude relative to full scale; never independently RMS-normalize captures. No SPL calibration.
interpretation: Criteria select candidate tones for a later fresh prediction trial; they do not establish phase predictability, source attribution, or physical ANC. Unknown OS gain/processing can affect the comparison.

off_conditions.confirmation: User: Ready - fan is off and room is quiet

gain_setting: No application or OS gain changes made by this project; AGC/enhancements remain unknown and unverified.

on_conditions.fan: on, same speed and position requested
on_conditions.confirmation: User: Ready - fan is steady and room is quiet
